statement: ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → (∑' i : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (ε / 4 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ i)) = ENNReal.ofReal (ε / 2)
proof:
intro ε hε
rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fun i => by positivity) (summable_geometric_two.mul_left (ε / 4))]
rw [summable_geometric_two.tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_two]
congr 1
ring
